title: Fix stale _STORE/_EMBED import binding in pool_saturation_user.py
summary: PoolSaturationUser imports _STORE/_EMBED by value at module load (always None) instead of reading the live locustfile globals, so every BM-15 task fails an assert — 210k tracebacks / a 2.7M-line log in the one run inspected.
description:
Root cause: `benchmarks/load/pool_saturation_user.py` (lines ~55-61) does:

```python
from benchmarks.load.locustfile import (
    _EMBED,
    _RUN_TAG,
    _STORE,
    MemoryStoreUser,
)
```

`from module import name` binds the *current* value of `module.name` at import time. `locustfile.py` initializes `_STORE = None` / `_EMBED = None` at module scope (`locustfile.py:97,100`) and only assigns the real `MemoryStore`/embedding-provider instances later, inside its `@events.init` listener (`locustfile.py:125-141`), which runs after Locust has finished importing all locustfiles. So `pool_saturation_user.py`'s local `_STORE`/`_EMBED` names are permanently bound to `None` — the later reassignment inside `locustfile.py` is invisible to it.

Every task in `PoolSaturationUser` then hits `assert _STORE is not None and _EMBED is not None` (line 112) or `assert _STORE is not None` (line 154) unconditionally, on every single call. Verified in the run at https://github.com/priyanshu-krishnan1/yaadien/actions/runs/31242532940/job/93077463404 ("Nightly benchmark suite — Tier 2 (BM-21)", step "BM-15 pool-saturation sweep — pool=5"): 50 VUs over 2 minutes produced 210,234 `AssertionError` tracebacks and a 2.7-million-line job log before Locust exited 1.

The sibling file `benchmarks/load/scalability_tasks.py` hit this exact trap already and documents the fix in a comment at lines 81-82 ("A bare `from locustfile import _STORE` would create a local None binding"): it does `import benchmarks.load.locustfile as _lf` and references `_lf._STORE` / `_lf._EMBED` inside each task function, so it always reads the live, post-init value.

Fix: apply the identical pattern to `pool_saturation_user.py` — replace the `from ... import _STORE, _EMBED` with a module import (`import benchmarks.load.locustfile as _lf`), and change every `_STORE`/`_EMBED` reference in `task_search`/`task_remember`/anywhere else in the file to `_lf._STORE`/`_lf._EMBED`. `_RUN_TAG` and `MemoryStoreUser` can stay as direct imports since they don't get reassigned after import (`MemoryStoreUser` is a class definition, `_RUN_TAG` is set once before `@events.init` runs — confirm this before leaving them as-is).

Acceptance: run `DB2_POOL_SIZE=5 locust -f benchmarks/load/pool_saturation_user.py --headless -u 50 -r 5 -t 2m --csv /tmp/pool5 PoolSaturationUser` against a local Db2 container and confirm zero `_STORE is not None` / `_EMBED is not None` AssertionErrors in the output, real `ConnectionPoolExhausted`-driven exhaustion-rate numbers appear in the CSV instead of 100% assertion failures, and the job log stays in the thousands-of-lines range, not millions.
